future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Hybrid simulation-real data augmentation framework for RF fingerprinting
future_contributions.technical_approach: Develop a domain adaptation pipeline combining simulated CAAs with real-world measurements from USRP X310 and ZigBee nodes, using adversarial training to bridge distribution gaps between synthetic and physical environments.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables robust authentication in heterogeneous environments by reducing reliance on idealized simulations while maintaining computational efficiency
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Feasible via existing simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink) and hardware testbeds with incremental data collection protocols

future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Hardware-agnostic synthetic RF fingerprint generation system
future_contributions.technical_approach: Create a parametric model of IoT device hardware (antenna geometry, RF front-ends) to generate synthetic fingerprints across device architectures, validated against real measurements from diverse platforms
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables benchmarking across heterogeneous IoT ecosystems without requiring physical device access
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Achievable through physics-based RF simulation frameworks with modular hardware parameterization

future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Open-set RF fingerprinting benchmark suite with standardized metrics
future_contributions.technical_approach: Curate a multi-device dataset with annotated open-set samples, define standardized metrics (F1-score, rejection rate, calibration error), and implement a reproducible evaluation toolkit
future_contributions.expected_impact: Facilitates fair comparison of open-set recognition methods across different hardware and environments
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Practical through collaborative data curation and containerized benchmarking infrastructure

future_contributions.gap: Underdeveloped theoretical foundations for I/Q imbalance modeling
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Formal mathematical framework for I/Q imbalance as device fingerprint
future_contributions.technical_approach: Derive analytical models linking I/Q imbalance parameters to device-specific hardware characteristics, validated through signal processing analysis of real-world measurement datasets
future_contributions.expected_impact: Provides theoretical basis for robust feature extraction and improves understanding of imbalance as a fingerprinting mechanism
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Feasible through signal processing analysis of existing datasets with mathematical modeling techniques
